item.title: New Zealand all-rounder, who played only 28 Tests in 14 years, announces retirement from cricket
item.description: New Zealand all-rounder Doug Bracwell announced his retirement today from all forms of the game due to a persistent rib injury that kept him out of action for Central Districts this season. Bracewell played 28 Tests, 21 ODIs and 20 T20Is in a career that spanned 14 years.

item.title: Tripura student killing: Police send team to Nepal; Dhami promises action | What we know so far
item.description: Tripura student killing: Of the six accused, five have been held but Yagyaraj Awasthi, who is a resident of Kanchanpur district of Nepal, is absconding. The police have announced a reward of Rs 25,000 for his arrest and send a team to Nepal to track him down.

item.title: Prostate cancer in men: Symptoms, risks and early detection explained
item.description: Prostate cancer is one of the most common cancers in men but often goes unnoticed. Experts stress early screening, awareness of subtle symptoms and timely testing to improve outcomes.

item.title: Sonam Yeshey of Bhutan creates world record, becomes first ever player to pick 8 wickets in a T20I
item.description: Bhutan bowler Sonam Yeshey returned with magical figures of 8/7 in four overs against Myanmar in the third T20I. He became the first bowler to do so in a T20 game, men or women, international or otherwise, even as seven wickets have been picked by four players in Men's T20 cricket.

item.title: Future of Vodafone Idea? Minister Scindia clarifies outlook amid pending dues, govt owing 49% stake
item.description: Vodafone Idea has formally notified the Department of Telecommunications of its critical financial state, highlighting a total liability to the government of approximately Rs 2 lakh crore.
